changelog:
v1.24.6 - Adjust mirror prop explosion delay to 0.5s and implement red telegraphed warning ring for bleed damage.
v1.24.5 - Fix prop models fallback to placeholders in exported builds by replacing FileAccess.file_exists with ResourceLoader.exists in Prop.gd.
v1.24.4 - Add pre-heat asset import caching step to CI/CD pipeline and configure it to use the opengl3 rendering driver to prevent headless texture compression glitches.
